faq.question: Can beginners join this program?
faq.answer: Yes. The program is designed from the ground up for ambitious beginners as well as intermediate creators. We begin in Month 1 with foundational platform dynamics, niche selection, and channel setup before progressing through scripting, cinematography, video editing, analytics, and business operations.

faq.question: Is an existing YouTube channel required before enrolling?
faq.answer: No. You do not need an existing channel or any prior subscribers. In Month 1, instructors guide you through creating and customizing a brand-new channel using an enterprise Brand Account structure, or auditing an existing channel if you already operate one.

faq.question: Which video editing software is taught in the course?
faq.answer: The primary non-linear editor (NLE) taught is Adobe Premiere Pro, which is the broadcast industry standard for YouTube video production. For students utilizing studio labs with alternative workflows, DaVinci Resolve is fully supported with feature parity across all timeline exercises, J/L cuts, sound design, and color grading.

faq.question: Is Adobe Photoshop included in the training?
faq.answer: Yes. Module 09 is dedicated to professional thumbnail design in Adobe Photoshop. You will learn subject cutout masking, rim light painting, typography, visual hierarchy, mobile feed readability, and layer compositing. Note that software subscriptions are not bundled into the tuition and must be arranged separately.

faq.question: Are video scriptwriting and storytelling covered?
faq.answer: Yes. Module 04 focuses extensively on 2-column Audio-Visual (AV) scriptwriting, 30-second retention hook formulas, narrative pacing, beat sheets, and eliminating throat-clearing intros that cause viewer abandonment.

faq.question: Will learners record original videos?
faq.answer: Yes. This is an active production program. In Month 2, you will record original A-roll footage, film dedicated B-roll, set up 3-point studio lighting, and calibrate professional audio capture. Stock footage can support your projects, but original filming is mandatory.

faq.question: How many long-form videos are required for graduation?
faq.answer: Students must complete three original, fully polished long-form master video productions (6–10 minutes each, master audio mixed to -14 LUFS). The video finished in Month 2/3 counts as the first production, followed by two additional distinct productions developed across Months 4 and 5.

faq.question: How many YouTube Shorts are required?
faq.answer: Students must complete at least eight finished vertical YouTube Shorts (9:16 aspect ratio, 30–60 seconds). The six Shorts produced in Month 3 count toward this total, supplemented by two additional Shorts in subsequent modules.

faq.question: Are thumbnail design and title copywriting covered together?
faq.answer: Yes. We teach the 'Thumbnail-Title Partnership' in Module 09. Thumbnails create emotional curiosity and visual stopping power, while titles provide context and clarity. You will learn how to make them complement each other without redundant text repetition.

faq.question: Is YouTube SEO taught?
faq.answer: Yes. Module 10 covers modern semantic YouTube SEO: intent-based keyword research, writing 300+ word descriptions, structuring timestamp chapters that generate Google Search Key Moments, closed captions (.srt), and thematic playlists.

faq.question: How does the YouTube recommendation algorithm work?
faq.answer: The algorithm is not a single gatekeeper; it is an audience feedback system designed to match individual viewers with videos they are most likely to watch and enjoy. It evaluates viewer satisfaction signals (watch time, average percentage viewed, completion rates, shares, and post-watch surveys) rather than superficial vanity tags.

faq.question: Will students learn to use YouTube Studio Analytics?
faq.answer: Yes. Module 11 provides deep hands-on training in YouTube Studio Analytics, covering Impressions, Impressions Click-Through Rate (CTR), Traffic Sources (Browse vs Suggested vs Search), and cohort tracking of New vs Returning Viewers.

faq.question: Is audience retention analyzed in depth?
faq.answer: Yes. You will learn to perform forensic autopsies on the 4 retention curve signatures: Intro Dips (first 30s failure), Spikes (rewatches/highlights), Dips (boring/confusing sections), and Flat Plateaus (continuous engagement), correlating audience drop-offs with exact video timestamps.

faq.question: Can students perform native YouTube A/B tests?
faq.answer: Yes. Module 09 and Module 12 cover YouTube's native 'Test & Compare' tool, which allows creators to test up to three thumbnail variations on eligible public long-form videos and evaluates performance based on Watch Time Share.

faq.question: What if a student's channel lacks eligibility for native A/B testing?
faq.answer: Native YouTube 'Test & Compare' requires public long-form videos with sufficient traffic velocity and is not supported for Shorts, private, or Made-for-Kids videos. When an active channel does not meet eligibility thresholds, students formulate and execute a structured, documented A/B simulation protocol rather than fabricating results.

faq.question: What is Ask Studio?
faq.answer: Ask Studio is YouTube Studio's conversational AI feature rolling out to creator channels, allowing creators to query their channel analytics, summarize viewer comments, identify search trends, and brainstorm video ideas using natural language prompts.

faq.question: Can under-18 learners use Ask Studio?
faq.answer: Feature availability depends on Google account age, regional rollouts, and channel tier. Where account age policies or rollout status restrict access to Ask Studio, students use simulated prompt protocols and primary YouTube Studio Analytics data.

faq.question: Are AI video editing tools covered?
faq.answer: Yes. Module 07 explores Premiere Pro's text-based editing, automated speech-to-text transcription, AI audio cleanup (Speech Enhancement), and silence detection, with strict emphasis on human review and error correction.

faq.question: Is automatic multi-language dubbing included?
faq.answer: Yes. Module 10 covers YouTube's automated multi-language audio (MLA) dubbing features, explaining eligibility, audio track management, and localization workflows for reaching regional and global audiences.

faq.question: How are copyright and synthetic media handled in the curriculum?
faq.answer: Module 14 provides rigorous instruction on Content ID claims vs copyright strikes, commercial music licensing, and YouTube's official Altered/Synthetic Content policy (https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/14328491), teaching exactly when to check the synthetic media disclosure box at upload.

faq.question: Does the course teach monetization and earning revenue?
faq.answer: Yes. Module 13 covers the 12 YouTube revenue streams: watch-page ads, YouTube Premium, Shorts ad sharing, Memberships, Super Chat/Thanks, YouTube Shopping, affiliate marketing, sponsorships, digital products, and creator services.

faq.question: What are the February 1, 2027 YouTube Partner Program (YPP) changes?
faq.answer: As published in official YouTube policies (https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/12843009), starting February 1, 2027, entry thresholds for new creators accessing ad/Premium revenue increase to 1,000 subscribers and 8,000 qualified public watch hours in 365 days OR 20 million qualified Shorts views in 90 days. Fan-funding remains accessible at lower thresholds (500 subscribers, 3 uploads, 3,000 watch hours or 3M Shorts views). Existing YPP creators are not automatically subject to new entry thresholds.

faq.question: Is monetization or YouTube Partner Program approval guaranteed?
faq.answer: No. Monetization requires formal review and approval by YouTube's human compliance team. Nova Skills does not guarantee YPP acceptance, viewer numbers, or advertising revenue. We teach the exact operational and legal requirements to maximize your eligibility.

faq.question: Are brand sponsorships guaranteed?
faq.answer: No. We teach you how to build professional Media Kits, calculate rate cards, pitch brands, and negotiate usage rights, but Nova Skills does not guarantee commercial brand contracts or third-party sponsorship deals.

faq.question: Is a live, public YouTube channel required to pass the course?
faq.answer: No. Public video publication is optional. Students who have privacy, employment, age, or copyright restrictions may submit their projects via unlisted links, private screening rooms, or local file archives. Private portfolios are graded with identical academic rigor.

faq.question: Can private or unlisted video portfolios be assessed?
faq.answer: Yes. Academic evaluation is based on the quality of your research, scripts, raw footage, editing craft, audio engineering, metadata architecture, and business assets, regardless of whether your video is public or private.

faq.question: What is the final industry capstone project?
faq.answer: The final capstone is the 'YouTube Creator Business Launch', an integrated 5-component project comprising Channel Strategy, Video Portfolio (3 master long-form videos + 8 Shorts), Publishing & Analytics Dossier, Creator Business Plan with Media Kit, and a 90-day Roadmap defended before an academic panel.

faq.question: What certificate is awarded upon completion?
faq.answer: Graduates who complete all 15 modules, meet the 70% threshold across the 6 assessment domains, and defend their capstone receive the Nova Skills Professional Certificate in YouTube Growth & Content Strategy (subject to institute approval and assessment).

faq.question: What is the course fee?
faq.answer: The regular course fee is INR 29,900. Nova Skills maintains a transparent pricing policy with 0% artificial discounts and zero inflated fake cross-outs.

faq.question: Is GST extra on the course fee?
faq.answer: Yes. Applicable statutory Goods and Services Tax (GST) of 18% (INR 5,382) applies, bringing the total fee to INR 35,282.

faq.question: Is an EMI or installment payment plan available?
faq.answer: Yes. Approved flexible installment and EMI options are available through authorized academic banking partners, subject to student credit verification and institute approval.

faq.question: Are paid software subscriptions included in the course fee?
faq.answer: No. Subscriptions to Adobe Creative Cloud (Premiere Pro, Photoshop) or third-party tools are not included in the tuition. Students may utilize educational student discounts, free lab alternatives (such as DaVinci Resolve), or institute on-campus editing suites.

faq.question: Does the program teach sustainable growth rather than algorithm hacks?
faq.answer: Yes. We strictly reject keyword stuffing, tag obsession, purchased views, sub4sub schemes, and algorithm 'tricks'. We teach sustainable media production: understanding viewer psychology, delivering genuine educational or entertainment value, mastering retention editing, and building an ethical creator business.

Topic 04: Sponsorship Compliance — Paid-promotion upload disclosure checkbox; in-video sponsorship disclosure; ASCI (Advertising Standards Council of India) influencer guidelines; FTC endorsement compliance; substantiating brand claims; honest product reviews; disclosing conflicts of interest; prohibited and restricted advertising categories; brand safety standards; preserving audience trust.

Topic 05: Community Management — YouTube Studio comment moderation suite; held-for-review filters and automated blocked words; responding professionally to critical feedback; managing trolls and defusing harassment; reporting community guideline violations; fostering a loyal, civil subscriber community; reputation preservation.

Topic 06: Production Operations — Designing modular creator SOPs; multi-stage editorial review checklists; client/internal content approvals; fact-checking workflows; maintaining a Licensing Register (.xlsx); folder taxonomies and metadata tagging; 3-2-1 backup protocol (3 copies, 2 media types, 1 offsite/cloud); scheduled publishing; role-based channel permissions (Manager vs Editor vs Subtitle Editor); account security hardening (FIDO2 keys, anti-phishing hygiene).

Topic 07: Sustainability — Calibrating sustainable publishing capacity; production time and financial budgeting; task delegation and assistant outsourcing; avoiding creator overwork and algorithmic exhaustion; quality over volume philosophy; ethical, durable audience growth.
